name: claude-code-delegate
description: Durably delegate bounded code implementation and test-repair loops to a local Claude Code CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded implementation to local Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Codex plans and reviews while a restricted local Claude Code worker edits files. Durable jobs support visible Windows execution, structured verification, bounded repair, timeouts, recovery, and cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use Claude Code to implement this change, verify it, and review the result.
Delegate this bug fix to Claude Code with a bounded test-repair loop.
